description: Use this when someone asks where they can fly cheaply from a city, or for flight deals under a budget or in a month. Returns the cheapest fare on each route with fares from an origin (or into a destination), cheapest one-way first, each with its cheapest round trip of a 3 to 21 day stay in `return` when the route has one. Filter by a maximum price and a departure month here rather than by reading the list; both apply to the one-way. Prices are for one adult in economy; each fare carries found_at, the day it was found (or checked, the day its route was last checked, when it has none), and a one-way may carry typical_price and pct_below_typical.

from.description: where the flights leave from: origin IATA airport or city code (NYC covers JFK, LGA and EWR); give from, to or both

limit.description: how many routes to return, 1 to 20; 10 when omitted

max_price.description: keep only fares at or under this amount, in the currency the results carry

month.description: YYYY-MM: the cheapest fare departing in that month; needs from

to.description: where the flights land: destination IATA airport or city code

name: cheapest_routes

book_url.description: opens the seller's booking page for this fare, where the final price and bag fees appear at checkout

checked.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day this route was last checked; found_at, when present, is the day this fare was found

departs.description: local departure time with the airport's offset

duration.description: flying time; on a return, both directions together

found_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day this fare was found; absent when only checked is known

lands.description: local arrival time with the airport's offset

month.description: YYYY-MM, on a per-month row that has no single date

page_url.description: the route's page on a2bflight.com — give the user this link first

pct_below_typical.description: one-way only: how many percent this fare is under typical_price; present only when 10 or more

return.description: the route's cheapest round trip of a 3 to 21 day stay; absent when the route has none, and the route's page_url then offers a return search
